title: 第15章 客院夜话 中第16章 客院夜话 下
slug: 修仙开局一部手机修为全靠买
content_zh:
他看了好一会儿，然后回到屋里，在床沿上坐下来。
这间客房比他青石镇的破屋子大了至少三倍。床铺的软硬适中，被褥是新的，散发着淡淡的艾草香。桌上摆着文房四宝，茶壶里的茶还是热的，窗台上甚至放了一小盆含苞待放的寒梅——不知道是客院的标配，还是有人特意放的。这所有的一切都在告诉他，他已经不在那个四处漏风的土坯房里了。
但他反而有些坐立不安。
太舒服了。舒服得不像是他该待的地方。他在青石镇待了三个月，习惯了在漏风的屋子里盘腿修炼，习惯了数着兜里的灵石过日子，习惯了一步算错就可能没命的紧绷感。画梅宗客院里这份安逸，让他觉得浑身都不自在。
刘叙白在床边坐了一会儿，站起来在屋里走了两圈，最后还是盘腿坐到床上，照常运转灵力走了一个小周天。丹田里的灵力比几天前又壮实了一分，虽然距离炼气四层还有不小的距离，但在他持续的巩固下，根基已经在稳步扎实了。收功之后，他掏出手机，点开了墟市。
灰蒙蒙的雾气中，货架上的光芒有了明显变化。之前那些锁着的货架上，有好几排都亮起了微弱的白光——筑基期区域解锁了一大片。这印证了他之前的推测，墟市的解锁范围和修为挂钩。他突破到炼气三层之后，筑基期的部分低阶物品已经开始对他开放了。虽然大部分筑基期的东西他还买不起，但至少能看到了，能规划了。
他的目光在筑基期区域里扫了一遍，迅速锁定了几样东西：一柄下品灵器级的青锋剑胚，售价二百二十枚下品灵石；一枚筑基丹的下位替代品“聚基丹”，售价一百八十枚；还有一件他之前就在炼气期区域见过但买不起的防御性法器图纸——“灵光盾”，售价九十五枚灵石。
每一个都贵得让人肉疼，但每一个都是实打实能在关键时刻救命的东西。刘叙白把这三样全部加入了收藏夹，然后看了看自己的余额——卖掉青石镇带出来的零散草药和杂物之后，他现在身上总共只有不到四十枚灵石。
路还很长。
他正准备关掉墟市，目光忽然被货架最边缘一个不起眼的角落吸引了。那里有一枚灰扑扑的晶石，只有指甲盖大小，颜色混沌不清，标价只要三十枚下品灵石，比同类物品低了至少一个数量级。标注也很模糊——“残损剑意石，品级不明，含有一道未完成的剑意残片，感悟成功率极低，失败后剑意石自行碎裂，概不退换。”
残损货。说白了就是赌石。成功了好处大，失败了三十枚灵石打水漂。墟市里这种不确定性极高的东西刘叙白一般不看，但这枚剑意石的标注里提到“剑意”两个字，让他心里动了一下。《悟道剑诀》的核心是悟性，悟性需要见识来支撑。他到现在为止见过的最高明的剑法就是苏清欢那几招画梅宗的阴柔剑招和《悟道剑诀》的基础三式，真正的剑意他连概念都没摸清楚。
三十枚灵石，赌一个感悟机会。失败了就剩下不足十枚灵石的活命钱，连在画梅宗跑路都不够。
刘叙白盯着那枚剑意石看了很久，最终没有急着购买。他把手机收好，重新躺回床上，望着天花板上精致的木雕纹路，脑子里翻来覆去地盘算着。明天去看陈砚，然后去找苏清欢，弄清楚画梅宗现在到底是什么局势。等一切信息都明朗了，再决定用不用这枚剑意石。
他正想着，忽然听到露台外面传来一阵极其轻微的声响。
那不是风声，也不是积雪从屋檐上滑落的声音。是一种有节奏的、刻意压低的脚步声，踩在积雪上，沙沙响了两下，然后停了。位置很近，就在他这间客房的露台下方。
刘叙白无声地从床上翻身而起，右手已经握住了床边的精铁长剑。裂纹剑虽然废了，但他还是随身带着，吓唬人也够用。他贴在墙壁上，屏住呼吸，透过露台木门上的雕花缝隙往外看去。
月光很淡，露台外面只有几棵松树的影子在风里晃。露台正下方的地面上，积雪反射着微弱的银光，上面印着一行新鲜的脚印。脚印从客院侧面的小径上岔过来，在露台下方停了一会儿，又沿着原路折回去了。显然，有人趁夜摸到客院，试图窥探他的动静，但大概是发现他还醒着，露台上有光，没有进一步动作就撤了。
刘叙白盯着那行脚印，目送它消失在松林深处。
画梅宗的客院，入夜之后有人摸到窗外来。这绝不是巧合，也不是什么迷路的弟子。他刚进宗门第一天，什么人会对他一个散修感兴趣？要么是苏清欢的对头想通过他来探苏清欢的底细，要么是想知道江晴雪为什么如此重视一个从外面带回来的散修。不论哪种可能，都说明了一件事——画梅宗的水，比他预想的还要浑。
刘叙白没有追出去。他放下剑，重新坐回床上，但没有再躺下。他把长剑横在膝上，靠着床头，闭上了眼睛。

呼吸平稳，像是睡着了。
但他的手始终搁在剑柄上。
一夜无事。天蒙蒙亮的时候，屋外传来了轻微的叩门声。三下，不急不缓，节奏从容。刘叙白睁开眼——一夜未睡，但精神还好，运转过灵力之后并不觉得特别疲惫。他起身开门，门外站着一个端着托盘的年轻侍女，托盘上放着一碗热粥、两碟小菜和一个白面馒头。
“刘公子早，沈管事吩咐卯时送早膳过来。公子有什么忌口的话，只管告诉奴婢，明日厨房好安排。”
刘叙白接过托盘道了声谢。他在桌边吃早饭的时候，摊开客院里备的那份宗门地图仔细看了一遍。流云峰东侧，医舍的位置标得很清楚。他几口喝完粥，把馒头叼在嘴里，披上外袍出了门。
清晨的流云峰笼罩在一层薄雾里，石阶两侧的灵植叶片上凝着晶莹的霜珠。演武场上已经有早起的弟子在练剑，剑光在雾中若隐若现。刘叙白穿过演武场边缘，沿着地图指示的小径走到医舍门口。

content_en:
He stared for a long time, then returned to the room and sat down on the edge of the bed.
This guest room is at least three times larger than his shabby house in Qingshi Town. The bed is of moderate softness and hardness, and the bedding is new, exuding a faint scent of mugwort. The four treasures of the study were placed on the table, the tea in the teapot was still hot, and there was even a small pot of budding plums on the window sill - I don't know if it was a standard feature of the guest house, or someone put it there specially. All of this told him that he was no longer in that adobe house that was leaking air everywhere.
But instead he felt a little restless.
So comfortable. It was too comfortable to be where he should be. He stayed in Qingshi Town for three months. He was used to practicing cross-legged in a drafty room, used to living by counting the spiritual stones in his pocket, and used to the tight feeling that one miscalculated step could lead to his death. The comfort in Hua Mei Zong's guest house made him feel uncomfortable all over.
Liu Xubai sat by the bed for a while, stood up and walked around the room twice. Finally, he sat cross-legged on the bed and walked for a small week as usual using his spiritual power. The spiritual power in Dantian is stronger than a few days ago. Although it is still far from the fourth level of Qi Refining, with his continuous consolidation, the foundation has been steadily solidified. After finishing his work, he took out his mobile phone and opened the market.
In the gray fog, the light on the shelves changed significantly. Several rows of the previously locked shelves were lit up with faint white light - a large area of ​​the foundation-building period was unlocked. This confirmed his previous speculation that the unlocking range of the market was linked to cultivation level. After he broke through to the third level of Qi Refining, some low-level items in the foundation-building stage were already available to him. Although he can't afford most of the things in the foundation building period, he can at least see and plan.
His eyes scanned the Foundation Establishment Stage area and quickly locked onto a few things: a low-grade spiritual weapon-level Qingfeng Sword embryo, priced at 220 low-grade spirit stones; a lower-grade substitute for the Foundation Establishment Pill, the "Juji Dan", priced at 180 stones; and a drawing of a defensive magic weapon that he had seen before in the Qi Refining Stage area but could not afford - the "Aura Shield", priced at 95 spirit stones.
Each one is painfully expensive, but each one is a real life-saving item at critical moments. Liu Xubai added all three items to his favorites, and then looked at his balance - after selling the scattered herbs and sundries brought out from Qingshi Town, he now only has less than forty spiritual stones in his body.
The road is still long.
He was about to close the market when his eyes were suddenly attracted to an inconspicuous corner at the edge of the shelf. There was a gray crystal stone, only the size of a fingernail, with a chaotic color. The price was only thirty low-grade spiritual stones, which was at least an order of magnitude lower than similar items. The label is also very vague - "The damaged Sword Intent Stone is of unknown grade and contains an unfinished Sword Intent fragment. The success rate of enlightenment is extremely low. The Sword Intent Stone will break into pieces upon failure and will not be returned."
Damaged goods. To put it bluntly, it is gambling on stones. If it succeeds, the benefits will be great, but if it fails, thirty spiritual stones will be wasted. Liu Xubai usually didn't look at such highly uncertain things in the market, but the word "Sword Intent" mentioned in the label of this Sword Intent Stone made him feel moved. The core of "The Sword Art of Enlightenment" is understanding, which requires knowledge to support it. The most brilliant swordsmanship he has ever seen so far is Su Qinghuan's feminine sword moves that draw Mei Zong and the three basic moves of "Enlightenment Sword Art". He doesn't even have a clear idea of ​​the true sword intention.
Thirty spiritual stones, a chance to gain enlightenment. If he fails, he will have less than ten spiritual stones left to survive, which is not even enough to run away in Hua Mei Sect.
Liu Xubai stared at the Sword Intent Stone for a long time, but in the end he was not in a hurry to buy it. He put the phone away and lay back on the bed, looking at the exquisite wood carvings on the ceiling, thinking over and over again in his mind. I'll go see Chen Yan tomorrow, and then go see Su Qinghuan to find out what the Plum Painting Sect is now.situation. Once all the information is clear, you can decide whether to use this Sword Intent Stone or not.
As he was thinking, he suddenly heard an extremely slight sound coming from outside the terrace.
It wasn't the sound of wind, or the sound of snow falling from the eaves. It was a kind of rhythmic, deliberately low footsteps, stepping on the snow, rustling twice, and then stopped. The location was very close, just below the terrace of his room.
Liu Xubai silently stood up from the bed, his right hand already holding the fine iron sword beside the bed. Although the cracked sword was useless, he still carried it with him, and it was enough to scare people. He pressed against the wall, held his breath, and looked out through the carved gaps in the wooden terrace door.
The moonlight was very faint, and outside the terrace there were only the shadows of a few pine trees swaying in the wind. On the ground directly below the terrace, the snow reflected a faint silver light, and there was a line of fresh footprints printed on it. The footprints branched off from the path on the side of the guest house, stopped for a while under the terrace, and then turned back along the original path. Apparently, someone went into the guest house at night and tried to spy on him, but they probably found that he was still awake and there was light on the terrace, so they withdrew without further action.
Liu Xubai stared at the set of footprints and watched them disappear deep into the pine forest.
In Hua Mei Zong's guest house, someone touched the window after dark. This is definitely not a coincidence, nor is this a lost disciple. On his first day after entering the sect, who would be interested in him as a casual cultivator? Either Su Qinghuan's enemies want to use him to find out about Su Qinghuan's background, or they want to know why Jiang Qingxue attaches so much importance to a casual cultivator brought back from outside. No matter which possibility it was, it meant one thing - the water in Mei Zong was muddier than he expected.
Liu Xubai did not chase him out. He put down his sword and sat back on the bed, but did not lie down again. He put the sword across his knees, leaned against the head of the bed, and closed his eyes.
Breathing steadily, as if asleep.
But his hand remained on the hilt of his sword.
Nothing happened all night. When the sky was dark, there was a slight knock on the door outside the house. Three times, neither urgent nor slow, with a leisurely pace. Liu Xubai opened his eyes - he hadn't slept all night, but he was in good spirits. He didn't feel particularly tired after using his spiritual power. He stood up and opened the door. Outside stood a young maid carrying a tray. On the tray were a bowl of hot porridge, two plates of side dishes and a white-flour steamed bun.
"Good morning, Young Master Liu. Manager Shen has asked Mao Shi to bring breakfast. If Young Master has any taboos, just tell the servants that the kitchen will be well arranged tomorrow."
Liu Xubai took the tray and thanked him. While he was having breakfast at the table, he spread out the sect map prepared in the living room and read it carefully. On the east side of Liuyun Peak, the location of the medical building is clearly marked. He finished the porridge in a few mouthfuls, put the steamed bun in his mouth, put on his coat and went out.
Liuyun Peak in the early morning was shrouded in a layer of mist, and the leaves of the spiritual plants on both sides of the stone steps were covered with crystal beads of frost. There are already early-rising disciples practicing swordsmanship in the martial arts arena, and the light of the swords is vaguely visible in the fog. Liu Xubai walked through the edge of the martial arts field and followed the path indicated on the map to the door of the hospital.
